svg.title: The clearance is chosen decreasing with degree, so it also covers every projection degree used below. Other groups, their centers and their field expressions are read by a continuation constant along each current part’s normal directions; this permits use of ancestor-subtracted expressions as the exterior continuation, with their cancellations retained. Refine one nonsingleton part i into a proper partition U on an angular annular patch. Assign radius a to the new parts and leave the others unchanged.
